title: VOOL Commercial Pole – two 22 kW charging points with MID metering
description: A public charging pole with two 22 kW charging points, display, QR code payment, RFID and an optional MID meter.

sections.title: Public charging in one pole: two charging points, payment and a certified meter
sections.lead: For shops, offices, car parks and other sites where drivers pay for charging. Two independent 22 kW charging points with a display, QR code payment and an optional MID meter.

sections.title: Built for sites where charging is billed

items.title: Pay without an app
items.text: The driver scans the QR code on the display, sees the price and pays. Regular users start with an RFID card.

items.title: Metering you can invoice from
items.text: The MID version has a certified meter for each charging point, for billing by the kWh.

items.title: Shares the connection
items.text: Works with VOOL LMC Pro or LMC S, or with another system over OCPP or Modbus.

items.title: Made for outdoors
items.text: IK10 impact protection and IP54, on a 1.5 m aluminium pole.

items.title: Always connected
items.text: Built-in mobile connectivity, so no network cable has to reach the car park.

items.title: Software included
items.text: Pricing, payments, payouts and reports run on the VOOL platform. No fixed fee.

sections.title: Specifications

cells: Integrated; MID-certified meter as an option
Display with QR code, RFID/NFC reader
VOOL LMC Pro or LMC S; OCPP or Modbus

sections.note: Specifications can change before deliveries start. Ask us for the current datasheet.

items.title: AFIR and public charging
items.text: What public AC charging points must offer: ad hoc payment, price before charging, ISO 15118.

items.title: Public charging with VOOL
items.text: Set your price, appear on the maps drivers use and get paid for every session.

sections.title: Planning a public or semi-public site?
sections.lead: Send us the location, the number of parking spaces and your grid connection. We reply with a proposal and delivery times.
